See also: vw and vw.

English

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (initialism) /viːˈdʌbəljuː/, (full form) /ˈvoʊkswæɡən/
  • Audio (US):(file)

Proper noun

[edit]

VW

  1. Initialism of Volkswagen, a German car manufacturer.
    • 2020 March 27, Gwyn Topham, Fiona Harvey, “Carmakers accused of trying to use crisis to avert emissions crackdown”, in The Guardian‎[1]:
      The big German carmakers Daimler, VW and BMW have already indicated they are aiming to comply with the new CO2 targets regardless of the current situation.

German

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /faʊ̯ˈveː/
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

VW m (strong, genitive VW or VWs, plural VW)

  1. (healthcare) initialism of Verbandswechsel

Declension

[edit]
Declension of VW [masculine, strong]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun
nominative ein der VW die VW
genitive eines des VW, VWs der VW
dative einem dem VW den VW
accusative einen den VW die VW

Noun

[edit]

VW n (strong, genitive VW or VWs, plural VW or VWe)

  1. (insurance) abbreviation of Versorgungswerk

Declension

[edit]
Declension of VW [neuter, strong]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun
nominative ein das VW die VW, VWe
genitive eines des VW, VWs der VW, VWe
dative einem dem VW den VW, VWen
accusative ein das VW die VW, VWe

Proper noun

[edit]

VW (with an article) f (genitive VW, no plural)

  1. (insurance) initialism of Versicherungswirtschaft

Proper noun

[edit]

VW m or n (proper noun, strong, genitive VWs or VW's or (with an article) VW)

  1. initialism of Volkswagen (“car manufacturer”)

Noun

[edit]

VW m (strong, genitive VW or VWs or VW's, plural VW or VWs or VW's)

  1. initialism of Volkswagen (“car”)

Declension

[edit]
Declension of VW [masculine, strong]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun
nominative ein der VW die VW, VWs, VW's
genitive eines des VW, VWs, VW's der VW, VWs, VW's
dative einem dem VW den VW, VWs, VW's
accusative einen den VW die VW, VWs, VW's

Usage notes

[edit]
  • In both senses the initialism is much more common in German than the full form.
